summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K to report that it exercised a top-up option to acquire an additional 4% equity interest in PredicXion Group Limited (K25.ai) for aggregate consideration of US$4,000,000, consisting of US$2,000,000 in cash or digital assets and 1,500,000 newly issued Class A ordinary shares. A cash deposit of US$300,000 was paid at signing, with the balance due by August 30, 2026. The closing is subject to customary conditions. No board recommendation or advisors named. This is a small minority stake acquisition, not a change-of-control special situation.
